clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, Cain Firesong sends a promising Forsaken mage to Anastasia Hartwell. Her summons calls you to the Magic Quarter for work among the Forsaken magi, with investigations in Tirisfal Glades ahead.

Cain Firesong trains young Forsaken mages in Brill, then sends those with promise to the Undercity. In its Magic Quarter, the Forsaken magi pursue arcane study and plan defenses across Lordaeron. Cain judges which students are ready to serve more experienced practitioners. Those who show real talent are sent to Anastasia Hartwell, who needs capable hands in the field.

Anastasia Hartwell is one of the Undercity's prominent mage instructors. She puts promising students to work for the Forsaken's practical and territorial interests instead of leaving them to study incantations in safety. Answering her call marks a step into service for the Forsaken's mages and their pragmatic magical work in the years after the Scourge.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, Anastasia Hartwell has a task for someone of your talents. Speak with her in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, and prepare yourself for your first task for the mages of the Forsaken.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Greetings, friend. You were wise to answer my call, and wiser still if you heed what I next say...

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
